title: Managed Backup: service resumption
content:
For Managed Backup, the service resumption basis governs contract resumption.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is suspended.

The contract payment restriction state is clear.

Restore a suspended holding after its official payment restriction clears; no customer promise substitutes for recorded clearance.

Set status active.

Bill resumption fee under lifecycle and bank-return fee rules only when positive, and preserve retained-resource history.

A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

## Authoritative evidence

Before contract resumption, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract status is suspended.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Status. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The recorded contract state for this action must be suspended.

Before contract resumption, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract payment restriction state is clear.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Payment restriction state. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The agent changes the contract from suspended to active.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The contract status is suspended.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical suspended contract has a customer promise to pay but its official restriction has not cleared. That promise does not satisfy the resumption condition. A closed contract cannot use resumption to become active.
